# 性能与资源需求质量 Checklist: 屏幕录制器 (Screen Recorder)

**Purpose**: 验证帧率、CPU/内存、长录制、停止时延等非功能需求是否量化、可测且与平台约束一致
**Created**: 2026-10-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are frame rate and resolution requirements specified for each capture mode? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is a CPU/GPU overhead budget specified or explicitly unavailable? [Gap, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are memory expectations for long recordings quantified? [Gap, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is the stop-to-playable latency quantified (SC-007) with recording-length bounds? [Completeness, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are startup-to-ready and menu-click-to-recording latency targets defined (SC-001)? [Completeness, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is disk throughput/space handling during recording specified? [Gap, Spec Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Is "≤10 秒发起录制" measurable without implementation ambiguity? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is "停止后 5 秒内可开始播放" clear about what "开始播放" means? [Clarity, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the user-rated performance criterion (SC-008 ≥4/5) defined with a scoring rubric? [Clarity, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are hardware baselines (CPU/GPU/display) for the performance targets defined? [Gap]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 - Do performance targets align with the supported Windows 10 minimum specification? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK012 - Does the no-audio scope reduce performance requirements consistently across the spec? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 - Can SC-003 environment coverage (Win10/Win11) be verified without hardware/OS ambiguity? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are performance acceptance criteria verifiable with monitoring methods defined in quickstart? [Measurability, Gap]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 - Are performance requirements defined for high-DPI and multi-monitor setups? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are performance requirements defined for recording animated or video-heavy content? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK017 - Are performance expectations specified for window-mode capture while the window is continuously resized? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is the acceptable impact on the target application (input latency, dropped frames) quantified? [Gap, Spec §SC-008]

## Non-Functional & Dependencies

- [ ] CHK019 - Is long-duration recording (≥1 hour) explicitly bounded in the requirements? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is power/battery behavior (keeping the display awake during recording) stated as a requirement or delegated? [Gap]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
